slides.notes: Introduce the project in one line: it moves Lovable-built apps into Emergent without a rewrite. Everything else in the deck explains how.

props.title: Easy to start. ==Hard to leave.==
props.body: AI app builders are great at getting to v1 — but when a project outgrows its builder, the code, structure, and platform assumptions are tangled together. A manual move means days of untangling before Emergent can even open the project.

slides.notes: Empathize with the pain: nobody plans to leave, but growth forces it. The cost isn't the new platform — it's untangling the old one.

props.title: A three-part toolkit for a ==clean import==.

items.title: Analyze
items.body: See exactly what your Lovable project contains — and what needs attention before a move.

items.title: Prep
items.body: Restructure the repo so it matches what Emergent expects, not what Lovable left behind.

items.title: Hand off
items.body: Give Emergent a project it can actually work with from the first prompt.

slides.notes: The mental model in three verbs: analyze, prep, hand off. Each maps to a concrete tool on the next slide.

tiles.title: Web analyzer
tiles.body: Inspects a Lovable project and reports what needs attention before you move — structure, dependencies, surprises.

tiles.title: CLI prep script
tiles.body: Restructures the repository for import, so the move is a command — not a week of file surgery.

tiles.title: MCP server
tiles.body: Lets an AI agent drive the migration steps directly — the same protocol Emergent's agents already speak.

slides.notes: One tool per job: analyze in the browser, prep on the command line, automate through MCP. The MCP server is the differentiator — an agent does the driving.

props.title: Four steps to a new home.

items.title: Analyze
items.body: Scan the Lovable project and review the report.

items.title: Prep
items.body: Run the CLI to restructure the repo for import.

items.title: Import
items.body: Bring the prepped project into Emergent.

items.title: Verify
items.body: Confirm the app runs clean in its new home.

slides.notes: Walk the arc end to end. Emphasize that verify closes the loop — you're not importing on faith.
